plugins.summaryZH: 使用设置中选定的 Codex、Claude Code 或通用 Open API（OpenAI 兼容）连接器生成独立目标缓冲区。
plugins.summaryEN: Generate an independent target buffer with the selected Codex, Claude Code, or OpenAI-compatible connector.

plugins.summaryZH: 把源缓冲区实时翻译到独立目标缓冲区；默认使用 Apple 本地翻译，也可选择当前 AI 渠道。
plugins.summaryEN: Translate the source buffer into an independent target buffer with Apple on-device translation by default or the current AI connector.

plugins.summaryZH: 连续输入不分词的全拼，按单独配置的 AI 渠道、1–5 个候选上限和响应节奏实时给出完整猜测。
plugins.summaryEN: Continuously interpret unsegmented full Pinyin with an independent AI connector, a one-to-five candidate limit, and a configurable response pace.
